findings.title: Discord thread orphaned if store.insert throws after postTaskCreated
findings.detail: In DiscordSource.ingest(), postTaskCreated() creates a Discord thread at line 112, then store.insert() is called at line 126. If insert throws (disk-full, UNIQUE violation, etc.) the thread exists in Discord but no task row is in the DB. A retry would create a second thread with no dedup anchor.
findings.fix_sketch: Insert a draft DB row first (possibly with state='pending' and no threadId), then post Discord, then patch the threadId back via patchSource. Alternatively wrap insert in a try/catch and post a deletion-note to the thread on failure.

findings.title: getAllPrDecisions throws on any unrecognised verdict row poisoning the full result set
findings.detail: store.getAllPrDecisions() used rows.map() with a throw on any unrecognised verdict string. A single legacy or future-schema row caused every caller (bandit trainer, dashboard) to receive an unhandled Error rather than the valid rows.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed throw to flatMap filter with console.warn so valid rows are still returned and the bad row is logged for investigation.

findings.title: listActiveSprints loads all sprints with no LIMIT causing unbounded memory growth
findings.detail: dashboard/server.ts listActiveSprints() issued SELECT with no LIMIT clause. After extended operation the sprints table accumulates thousands of completed rows; all are loaded into JS and then filtered in application code.
findings.fix_sketch: Added LIMIT 500 to the SQL query as a safety cap.

findings.title: getKgPool(overrideUrl) silently ignores override when pool is already cached
findings.detail: pg-client.ts line 31 returns cachedPool immediately before checking overrideUrl. Any call after first initialization silently gets the original pool regardless of the URL passed. Tests relying on overrideUrl to point at a test DB see the production pool instead.
findings.fix_sketch: If overrideUrl is provided and differs from the cached pool's connection string, end the old pool and create a new one. Or add a runtime assertion that throws in non-production when the override is silently ignored.

findings.title: bin.ifleet points to a .ts source file with a node (not tsx) shebang
findings.detail: package.json bin.ifleet points to packages/orchestrator-core/src/observability/tail-cli.ts. The shebang was #!/usr/bin/env node; Node.js cannot parse TypeScript directly so pnpm link or npm install -g produces SyntaxError on invocation.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed shebang to #!/usr/bin/env tsx so pnpm dlx / global install works. Long-term: point bin at compiled .js output.

findings.title: Hardcoded personal username @monstersebas1 as default PR approver in public repo
findings.detail: src/pipeline/runner.ts line 54 embeds @monstersebas1 as the approver fallback for every sprint missing an explicit approver. The string appears in plan-review messages, Discord output, and potentially PR bodies in a public repository — a needless PII exposure.
findings.fix_sketch: Changed fallback to read from IFLEET_DEFAULT_APPROVER env var, with @monstersebas1 as the final default. Operators can now override without a code change.

findings.title: resetsAt epoch-seconds assumption in claude.ts has no range sanity check
findings.detail: packages/orchestrator-core/src/workers/claude.ts multiplies resetsAt by 1000 assuming epoch seconds. If a future CLI version changes the field to milliseconds, retryDelayMs becomes 1000x too large, hanging the retry loop effectively forever.
findings.fix_sketch: Added sanity guard: if the multiplied value implies a delay > 30 min past now, assume the value is already in ms and use it directly.

findings.title: TaskStore.list(limit=0) silently returns empty array instead of throwing
findings.detail: LIMIT 0 in SQLite returns zero rows. Callers that accidentally compute limit=0 (e.g. a mis-computed page size) see an empty result and may interpret it as 'no tasks in queue' rather than a programming error.
findings.fix_sketch: Added RangeError guard at the top of list() when limit <= 0.

findings.title: .ts file extensions in ESM import paths in claude-cli.ts
findings.detail: packages/orchestrator-core/src/workers/adapters/claude-cli.ts imports with .ts extensions (lines 3-4). Works only because tsx hooks the resolver; native ESM compilation emits .js and the .ts imports fail at runtime with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
findings.fix_sketch: Change .ts extensions to .js to match the ESM output convention used throughout the rest of the repo.

findings.title: Box-Muller in thompson.ts discards second normal variate wasting two trig calls
findings.detail: standardNormal() returns only the cos-branch value and discards the sin-branch, wasting one Math.random() call and one trig operation per invocation. No correctness impact at current call volumes.
findings.fix_sketch: Cache the second variate in a module-level variable and return it on alternate calls (standard Box-Muller optimisation). Low priority — negligible impact.
